name: Database Mart Ollama benchmark, RTX PRO 2000 Blackwell (16 GB)
notes: Database Mart hosted-GPU report, page footer dated 10/07/2026. One NVIDIA RTX Pro 2000 Blackwell, 16 GB GDDR7 with ECC. Engine is Ollama; unlike the PRO 6000 page this one does not print the Ollama version. Quantization is the default Ollama pull, labelled INT4, exact GGUF quant not printed, so format_id is null. Prompt is the single question 'What is GPU?' and output length is model-determined, so only the eval-rate column (per-request decode, batch size 1) is recorded.
